english: This is the deepest lake in Japan.

chinese: 你是我唯一能信任的人。
pinyin: nǐ shì wǒ wéi yī néng xìn rèn de rén.
english: You're the only one I can trust.

chinese: 写下你名字的大写字母。
pinyin: xiě xià nǐ míng zi de dà xiě zì mǔ.
english: Write your name in capitals.

chinese: 慢慢来，不然你可能会出错的。
pinyin: màn màn lái, bù rán nǐ kě néng huì chū cuò de.
english: Take your time, or you may make some mistakes.

pinyin: zhè běn shū de míng zi shì shén me?
english: What's the title of the book?

chinese: 你所有的书我都看过了。
pinyin: nǐ suǒ yǒu de shū wǒ dōu kàn guo le.
english: I've read all your books.

chinese: 我没有一次演讲的时候是不紧张的。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu yī cì yǎn jiǎng de shí hou shì bù jǐn zhāng de.
english: I never make a speech without being nervous.

pinyin: wèi shén me nǐ jiě jie bù hǎo?
english: Why is it not okay if it's your sister?

pinyin: wǒ jiàn zào le zhè ge gěi nǐ de.
english: I built this for you.

pinyin: nǐ bù zài néng shāng hài dào wǒ le.
english: You can no longer hurt me.

pinyin: nǐ gǎn jué hǎo ma?
english: Are you feeling okay?

chinese: 那是一隻有惡意的兔子。
pinyin: nà shi yī zhī yǒu è yì de tù zi.
english: That was an evil bunny.

chinese: 你看过这么好看的电影吗？
pinyin: nǐ kàn guo zhè me hǎo kàn de diàn yǐng ma?
english: Have you ever seen such a nice film?

chinese: 你不想看我的行李箱裡有什麼嗎？
pinyin: nǐ bù xiǎng kàn wǒ de xíng li xiāng lǐ yǒu shén me ma?
english: Don't you want to see what I have in my suitcase?

pinyin: zhè shì wǒ néng wèi nín zuò de.
english: This is what I can do for you.

chinese: 他把他的手从桌上移开了。
pinyin: tā bǎ tā de shǒu cóng zhuō shàng yí kāi le.
english: He withdrew his hand from the table.

chinese: 这种科技的优势是什么？
pinyin: zhè zhǒng kē jì de yōu shì shì shén me?
english: What is the advantage of this technology?

pinyin: nà tài hǎo le, bù shì ma?
english: That's good, isn't it?

chinese: 她拿了其中一个玻璃花瓶。
pinyin: tā ná le qí zhōng yī gè bō li huā píng.
english: She picked up one of the glass vases.

pinyin: bié zài gēn wǒ shuō huà le!
english: Don't ever talk to me again!

pinyin: méi yǒu shuǐ, wǒ men wú fǎ shēng cún.
english: Without water, we cannot exist.

chinese: 我知道你不想去的真实原因。
pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù xiǎng qù de zhēn shí yuán yīn.
english: I know the real reason you don't want to go.

chinese: 我对自己说，“那是个好主意。”
pinyin: wǒ duì zì jǐ shuō, nà shi gè hǎo zhǔ yi.
english: I said to myself, "That's a good idea."

chinese: 你要更好地利用闲暇时间。
pinyin: nǐ yào gèng hǎo de lì yòng xián xiá shí jiān.
english: You should make better use of your free time.

pinyin: wǒ zhēn de gǎo bu dǒng wèi shén me.
english: I really can't figure out why.

chinese: 门铃响的时候，我正准备出门。
pinyin: mén líng xiǎng de shí hou, wǒ zhèng zhǔn bèi chū mén.
english: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.

pinyin: wǒ tīng gòu nǐ de bào yuàn le.
english: I've had enough of your complaints.

pinyin: wǒ men néng cǎi fǎng tā ma?
english: Can we interview him?

chinese: 我对她有很深刻的印象。
pinyin: wǒ duì tā yǒu hěn shēn kè de yìn xiàng.
english: I find her very impressive.

pinyin: nǐ zuò le bì yào de shì.
english: You did what was necessary.

chinese: 我不能想象他会做这种事。
pinyin: wǒ bù néng xiǎng xiàng tā huì zuò zhè zhǒng shì.
english: It is inconceivable to me that he would do such a thing.

pinyin: zhè shì wéi yī de rù kǒu.
english: This is the only way in.

chinese: 我不想再聽到你的抱怨了。
pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng zài tīng dào nǐ de bào yuàn le.
english: I do not want to hear your complaints again.

chinese: 我本想去参加音乐会的。
pinyin: wǒ běn xiǎng qù cān jiā yīn yuè huì de.
english: I wanted to go to the concert.

pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hou qù ōu zhōu?
english: When are you going to Europe?

pinyin: wǒ men hái kě yǐ zài jiàn miàn ma?
english: Could I see you again?

pinyin: wǒ bù gāi tuì chū de.
english: I shouldn't have logged off.

chinese: 我听到这个消息很惊讶。
pinyin: wǒ tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xi hěn jīng yà.
english: I was very surprised to hear the news.

pinyin: zì yóu shì yǒu dài jià de.
english: Freedom has a cost.

pinyin: nǐ gāi shàng xué qù le, bù shì ma?
english: It's high time you left for school, isn't it?

pinyin: tā cóng shén me dì fang lái de?
english: Where does he come from?

pinyin: nǐ bù shì zhù zài huò chē lǐ ma?
english: Don't you live in a van?

pinyin: nǐ shì zěn me xué huì shuō huà de?
english: How did you learn to speak?

chinese: 在这么冷的地方做什么？
pinyin: zài zhè me lěng de dì fang zuò shén me?
english: What are you doing in a freezing place like this?

chinese: 我会带你去安全的地方。
pinyin: wǒ huì dài nǐ qù ān quán de dì fang.
english: I will take you to a safe place.

pinyin: zhè ge dǎo zài rì běn de nán miàn.
english: This island is in the south of Japan.

pinyin: méi rén zài yì nǐ de kàn fǎ.
english: Nobody cares what you think.

chinese: 不要在意，不是你的问题。
pinyin: bù yào zài yì, bù shì nǐ de wèn tí.
english: Don't worry about it. It's not your problem.

pinyin: nǐ bù shì gè bàng qiú mí ma?
english: Aren't you a baseball fan?

chinese: 算了，我们聊点开心的事吧！
pinyin: suàn le, wǒ men liáo diǎn kāi xīn de shì ba!
english: Forget it, let us talk about happy stuff!

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù nǐ yào qù de dì fang.
english: I want to go wherever you're going.

pinyin: nǐ yuàn yì jià gěi wǒ ma?
english: Will you marry me?

chinese: 有誰偷了我的網球球拍。
pinyin: yǒu shéi tōu le wǒ de wǎng qiú qiú pāi.
english: Someone has stolen my tennis racket.

pinyin: lái ma! gěi wǒ gè jī huì.
english: Come on! Give me a chance.

chinese: 我不是这个俱乐部的会员。
pinyin: wǒ bú shì zhè ge jù lè bù de huì yuán.
english: I'm not a member of the club.

pinyin: wǒ men àn lì chǔ fá le tā.
english: We punished him according to the rules.

chinese: 我的夢想是成為一名消防員。
pinyin: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī míng xiāo fáng yuán.
english: My dream is to become a firefighter.

pinyin: wǒ de shǒu biǎo hěn jīng zhǔn.
english: My watch is very precise.

pinyin: tā bù ràng wǒ men zhī dào zhēn xiàng.
english: She's hiding the truth from us.

chinese: 让我看看它是什么样的。
pinyin: ràng wǒ kàn kan tā shì shén me yàng de.
english: Let me see what it looks like.

pinyin: tā qǔ le yī gè kōng jiě.
english: He married a stewardess.

pinyin: nín zài yī gè ān quán de dì fang.
english: You are in a safe place.

pinyin: zhè shì shén me qì wèi?
english: What's this smell?

pinyin: zuì jìn de jǐng chá jú zài nǎ lǐ?
english: Where is the nearest police station?

pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ zài tā yǎn zhōng kàn dào.
english: I can see it in her eyes.

pinyin: wǒ kàn nǐ gāi zuò zhè jiāo yì.
english: I think you should make the deal.

pinyin: míng tiān, tā jiāng dēng shàng yuè qiú.
english: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

chinese: 我一直忙于写一部短篇小说。
pinyin: wǒ yī zhí máng yú xiě yī bù duǎn piān xiǎo shuō.
english: I've been busy writing a short story.

pinyin: xué xiào yīn dà xuě tíng kè yī tiān.
english: School was closed for the day due to the snow.

pinyin: hèn nǐ men de, yào dài tā hǎo.
english: Do good to those who hate you.

pinyin: tā tōu le wǒ de biǎo.
english: He stole my watch.

pinyin: tā shì gěi bī de.
english: He is being forced.

chinese: 你是我所知道的最聪明的人。
pinyin: nǐ shì wǒ suǒ zhī dào de zuì cōng ming de rén.
english: You're the smartest person I know.

chinese: 要是你来得了，那就太好了。
pinyin: yào shi nǐ lái de le, nà jiù tài hǎo le.
english: If you came, that would be great.

pinyin: zhè shì shén me yàng de niǎo r?
english: What kind of bird is this?

chinese: 我在想我今天该干什么。
pinyin: wǒ zài xiǎng wǒ jīn tiān gāi gàn shén me.
english: I wonder what I should do today.

chinese: 自然中没有什么是无用的。
pinyin: zì rán zhōng méi yǒu shén me shì wú yòng de.
english: Nothing in nature is useless.

chinese: 这种式样的钱包你们有卖吗？
pinyin: zhè zhǒng shì yàng de qián bāo nǐ men yǒu mài ma?
english: Do you sell this style of wallet?

pinyin: wǒ shì nǐ de dài lǐ rén.
english: I'm your deputy.

pinyin: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng hé nǐ zài yī qǐ.
english: I just want to be with you.

chinese: 有什么比失明更不幸的呢？
pinyin: yǒu shén me bǐ shī míng gèng bù xìng de ne?
english: What greater misfortune is there than to go blind?

chinese: 我能问一下您的姓名和住址吗？
pinyin: wǒ néng wèn yī xià nín de xìng míng hé zhù zhǐ ma?
english: Might I ask your name and address?

pinyin: wǒ huì gěi nǐ kāi ge yào fāng.
english: I'll give you a prescription.

pinyin: wǒ de zuǐ liè kāi le.
english: I have chapped lips.

chinese: 他看上去是一个十足的绅士。
pinyin: tā kàn shang qu shì yī gè shí zú de shēn shì.
english: He looks every inch a gentleman.

chinese: 我沒有想要讓你不知所措。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu xiǎng yào ràng nǐ bù zhī suǒ cuò.
english: I didn't mean to overwhelm you.

pinyin: tā hé wǒ tóng suì.
english: He is as old as I.

chinese: 由医生来决定某人何时该死是对的吗？
pinyin: yóu yī shēng lái jué dìng mǒu rén hé shí gāi sǐ shì duì de ma?
english: Is it right for a doctor to decide when someone should die?

chinese: 在一天之内完成它几乎是不可能的。
pinyin: zài yī tiān zhī nèi wán chéng tā jī hū shì bù kě néng de.
english: It's next to impossible to finish it in a day.

pinyin: tā de yǎn lǐ yǒng chū le lèi shuǐ.
english: Her eyes gushed with tears.

chinese: 和你昨晚在一起的人是谁？
pinyin: hé nǐ zuó wǎn zài yī qǐ de rén shì shéi?
english: Who was that you were with last night?

pinyin: wǒ zuó tiān dì yī cì dǎ wǎng qiú.
english: I played tennis yesterday for the first time.

pinyin: nán hái r qǔ xiào le nǚ hái r.
english: The boy made fun of the girl.

chinese: 别再扯你姐姐的头发了！
pinyin: bié zài chě nǐ jiě jie de tóu fa le!
english: Stop pulling your sister's hair.

chinese: 这是一个生和死的问题。
pinyin: zhè shì yī gè shēng hé sǐ de wèn tí.
english: It's a matter of life and death.

chinese: 那个孩子可能在回家的路上被绑架了。
pinyin: nèi ge hái zi kě néng zài huí jiā de lù shang bèi bǎng jià le.
english: That child may have been kidnapped on his way home.

chinese: 你们这些家伙想去干什么？
pinyin: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo xiǎng qù gàn shén me?
english: What are you guys going to do?

pinyin: nà shi yuán chuàng de xiǎng fǎ.
english: That's an original idea.

pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài bù néng hé nǐ liáo tiān.
english: I cannot talk to you now.

chinese: 这秘密是怎么泄漏出去的？
pinyin: zhè mì mì shì zěn me xiè lòu chū qù de?
english: How did the secret get out?

pinyin: wǒ tīng gòu nǐ de huǎng huà le.
english: I've had enough of your lies!

chinese: 你恳求与我谈话的原因是什么？
pinyin: nǐ kěn qiú yǔ wǒ tán huà de yuán yīn shì shén me?
english: What is your reason for soliciting a conversation with me?

pinyin: tā xiǎng hé wǒ men yī qǐ lái.
english: He wants to come with us.

chinese: 他们一直爬到悬崖顶上。
pinyin: tā men yī zhí pá dào xuán yá dǐng shàng.
english: They climbed to the top of a cliff.

chinese: 你不得不制造一些借口。
pinyin: nǐ bù dé bù zhì zào yī xiē jiè kǒu.
english: You'll have to make up some kind of excuse.

chinese: 她在他的背上戳了一下。
pinyin: tā zài tā de bèi shàng chuō le yī xià.
english: She stabbed him in the back.

chinese: 不是我告訴你不要去做的。
pinyin: bù shì wǒ gào su nǐ bù yào qù zuò de.
english: It wasn't me who told you not to do that.

chinese: 任何任务都可能变得费力。
pinyin: rèn hé rèn wu dōu kě néng biàn de fèi lì.
english: Any task may become painful.

chinese: 谁告诉你我和汤姆在交往的？
pinyin: shéi gào su nǐ wǒ hé tāng mǔ zài jiāo wǎng de?
english: Who told you that Tom and I are dating?

chinese: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
pinyin: shén me shì nín zuì dà de líng gǎn lái yuán?
english: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

chinese: 你和汤姆昨天做了什么？
pinyin: nǐ hé tāng mǔ zuó tiān zuò le shén me?
english: What were you and Tom doing yesterday?

chinese: 我知道你不自在，但别急。
pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù zì zai, dàn bié jí.
english: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.

pinyin: tǎn shuài de shuō, wǒ bù xǐ huan nǐ.
english: Frankly speaking, I don't like you.

chinese: 你对她是不是一见钟情？
pinyin: nǐ duì tā shì bù shì yī jiàn zhōng qíng?
english: Did you fall in love with her at first sight?

pinyin: tā shì wǒ de jiù mìng ēn rén.
english: I owe him my life.

chinese: 从这里到海滩该怎么走？
pinyin: cóng zhè lǐ dào hǎi tān gāi zěn me zǒu?
english: How do I get to the beach from here?
